priorFindingDisposition.howVerified: The defect was confirmed to have existed by reading frozen v8 directly rather than by reading any reviewer file. v8 retainedEvidence[4].passProperty read verbatim: 'The upgrade cell's passProperty. Clean and offline cells record AT-6 as not-applicable or blocked-on-ride, never as a performed rollback.' Clean, offline, and upgrade reports require AT-6 blocked-on-ride with the recorded ride ID-DEP-P3/DR-110/DR-112. not-applicable is excluded. Never a performed rollback.' priorFindingDisposition.landingIsCorrectAgainstUpstream: The fix was checked against the governing contract, not merely for internal tidiness. component-packaging-contract.v14 conformanceReport.fixtureMemberMap.members['AT-6'] records producer 'none', expected 'blocked-on-ride', ride 'ID-DEP-P3/DR-110/DR-112'. v9's EV-5 ride string is byte-equal to v14's ride string. v8 was therefore in conflict with v14 and v9 resolves that conflict in v14's direction.
priorFindingDisposition.landingIsComplete: A fix at one field that the rest of the document contradicts is not a landing. Checked every other site that could still offer the excluded standing: closedMap.blockedOnRideAtHalves fixes AT-6 at blocked-on-ride with the same ride; closedMap.rule bars not-applicable and blocked-on-ride for any rideless key; reportUnit.eachReport lists AT-6 among the four rided AT halves that stand blocked-on-ride on every one of the twelve reports and states the produced modifier applies to no rided key; matrixCells.upgrade.passProperty and exactByteIntent require the AT-6 blocked-on-ride record naming ID-DEP-P3; failsIf[15] fails a performed rollback. An exhaustive scan of every 'not-applicable' occurrence in the subject found nine, none of which offers that standing to AT-6.
priorFindingDisposition.residualNotApplicableOccurrences: Nine total. Two are historical narration (purpose, basedOn.predecessorV8.role describing what v8 did). One is failsIf[0], the negative guard. Three are prohibitions (at8.standing, closedMap.rule, failsIf[11]). One is EV-5's own exclusion. One is EV-3.exactByteIntent, where not-applicable is a lawful standing for a healthAndSubprotocol applicability[] member and requires ride AT-4/ID-DEP-P4. One is the top-level passProperty standing vocabulary. None reaches AT-6.
